purpose: Public snapshot of Qwen27B test scripts, numerical implementations, reports and selected real evidence; not private Git history.
redaction_policy: Live IPv4 endpoints replaced with RFC5737 examples; loopback/unspecified addresses preserved.
Local and remote home directories replaced with generic research/llm accounts.
Connection diagnostics, private settings, environment files, downloaded corpora/models, venvs and raw profiler binaries excluded.
Original source hashes identify pre-publication artifacts. Public hashes identify copied/sanitized files. Sanitized runtime metadata is not claimed byte-identical to private captures.
The single 1MiB frozen FP8 extension is included with source and locked SHA for working image-context preparation; all other compiled artifacts excluded.
publication_notes: Clean branch starts at original origin/main; private local experimental commit history is not published.
Publication entrypoints, relative documentation links, configurable deployment example and notices are editorial additions; original runtime numerical source lock is unchanged.
The manifest excludes itself to avoid a recursive digest.
Local publication validation is recorded in publication-validation.json; no live service was accessed during publication.
